Question
========
Which developments have weakened the redistributive role of the state? (Select all that apply.)

Answerlist
----------
* Lower top income tax rates
* Lower taxes on capital and corporations
* Austerity in social spending
* Rising union membership

Solution
========
Reduced tax progressivity, lower capital and corporate taxes, and austerity have all reduced redistribution. Union membership has declined, not risen.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* True
* True
* False
